jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, BigMesh, Traffic Engineering
jobs.description: Want to build a Service Mesh that powers Amazon at scale? Amazon Traffic Engineering delivers managed compute and networking solutions that help engineers build secure, highly available, and scalable services — all on top of AWS technologies. We drive the foundational infrastructure, tools, and best practices behind Amazon's global SOA expansion. As an SDE on the BigMesh team, you'll build centralized traffic management and networking solutions handling security, authentication, authorization, load balancing, and routing for Amazon's most critical services. Your work will directly improve availability, efficiency, and developer productivity by turning complex SOA concerns into managed abstractions that "just work." We use Golang, Rust, and Java. If you're new to any of these, our onboarding will get you up to speed. Come help make developing software at Amazon more seamless and flexible! Key job responsibilities - Own the full software development lifecycle for Service Mesh features, from design through implementation, testing, and production readiness. - Write high-quality, maintainable code in Golang, Rust, or Java that meets Amazon's engineering standards. - Collaborate with product managers, designers, and senior engineers to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions for traffic management and connectivity. - Design and build networking features (load balancing, routing, throttling, authentication) used by thousands of Amazon services. - Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, architecture discussions, and knowledge sharing. - Identify and drive process improvements that increase team efficiency and system reliability. - Participate in on-call rotation to resolve production issues and proactively mitigate operational risks. A day in the life - Ship code for high-impact Service Mesh features used across Amazon - Debug complex connectivity and dependency issues alongside partner teams - Review designs and guide Away-Team engineers on best practices - Advise stakeholders on technical trade-offs and effort estimates - Triage and resolve production issues during on-call rotation About the team You'll be joining the Big Mesh team, the team that owns services and connectivity solutions for Amazon's internal services. As part of this team, you'll be responsible for the ensuring we continue to develop better connectivity solutions for our Amazon teams and simplify/remove the hurdles the builders face as they navigate the complex networking architecture at Amazon. The team is always looking for ways to improve the engineer experience through process improvements and automation. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to these efforts and help shape the team's engineering practices. By joining this team, you'll play a critical role in delivering the core functionality that powers Amazon's internal connectivity solutions. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the shopping experience of millions of Amazon customers worldwide. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Annapurna Labs - LibNVMe
jobs.description: Annapurna Labs (our organization) designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world. LibNVMe is the customer-facing front-end interface for local and remote storage on EC2 instances, with a focus on HW/SW co-design and performance optimization. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join the LibNVMe team. You will design, build, and own features across the storage software stack, from optimizing storage protocols to keeping foundational EC2 infrastructure reliable. This is high-ownership work: your code runs on Nitro Cards in millions of EC2 servers, serving customers who demand the best storage performance. Key job responsibilities -Design and develop features for LibNVMe, the customer-facing front-end interface for EC2 local storage (instance store) and remote storage (Amazon EBS) on Nitro Cards. -Build deep knowledge of the NVMe specification and the I/O path, and use it to improve performance and reliability. -Work with Annapurna Labs hardware and firmware engineers to implement and test software/hardware interfaces. -Develop and maintain the drivers and libraries that give storage applications simple, secure APIs to Nitro Card hardware. -Work with AWS storage service teams to deliver features and resolve issues, diving into their code when needed. -Write high-quality, well-tested code, contribute to design and code reviews, and help onboard new teammates. -Contribute to operational excellence: improve observability and debuggability, take part in the on-call rotation, and help resolve incidents and their follow-ups. A day in the life Your day might include writing and reviewing code, working with hardware and firmware engineers on new features, or tracking down a performance bottleneck. You'll also help partner teams debug issues that span their stack and ours, and learn from senior engineers along the way. About the team The LibNVMe team is part of Annapurna Labs, which builds the custom silicon and software behind the AWS Nitro System. We work closely with AWS storage, hardware, and firmware teams, and we value ownership, mentorship, and helping each engineer grow. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of professional software development in C or C++ - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent - -Experience with storage protocols such as NVMe - -Experience in C or C++ on embedded, firmware, or kernel-level systems - -Experience with HW/SW co-design - -Experience with performance analysis and optimization - -Experience building secure systems software Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. If you're a self-starter who thrives on tackling complex technical challenges and collaborating with talented engineers, we'd love to hear from you.
